Oneliner

3Cat-8 is a scientific mission to monitor and characterise ionospheric scintillation. Deploys PocketQubes and has deployable Fresnel zone plate antenna.
Description

3Cat-8 is a scientific mission to monitor and characterise ionospheric scintillation – that is, the emission of light from a body excited by radiant energy – and to monitor radio frequency emissions in the L- and K-bands.

The CuPID PocketQube deployer, the first flight hardware of our newest mission, 3Cat-8, being integrated in the CubeSat structure.
Notes

Could be the same as 3CAT-3.
